pages.title: DTG-Compatible Products | Northwest Custom Apparel
pages.bodyText: DTG-Compatible Products High-quality garments perfect for Direct-to-Garment printing 100% cotton and high-cotton blends tested over 10+ years Tested & Verified Every product tested for DTG compatibility High Cotton Content 100% cotton or 50%+ cotton blends Vibrant Prints Perfect for full-color, detailed designs Why Fabric Content Matters for DTG Direct-to-Garment printing is a precise digital printing method that requires specific fabric types to achieve the best results. Unlike screen printing or embroidery, DTG ink bonds best with natural cotton fibers. Best Results: 100% cotton garments provide the most vibrant colors and longest-lasting prints Good Results: 50% or higher cotton blends work well for most designs Poor Results: Polyester, performance fabrics, and low-cotton blends don't accept DTG ink properly Pro Tip: All products on this page have been carefully selected and tested by our team to ensure excellent DTG printing results every time. pages.bodyText: SanMar Catalog Color Audit Diff Caspio's Sanmar_Bulk_251816_Feb2024 against SanMar's live mainframeColor. Read-only. ← Staff Dashboard Style # Run audit 0 In sync 0 Caspio mismatch (rejection candidates) 0 Caspio orphan (SanMar dropped it) 0 SanMar only (new colors) 0 Internal drift (Caspio rows disagree with themselves) Style: — Caspio rows: — Caspio unique colors: — SanMar live colors: — Generated: — Caspio Mismatches 0 Copy CSV Caspio's CATALOG_COLOR (and SANMAR_MAINFRAME_COLOR) don't match SanMar's current mainframeColor. These are the values likely getting rejected by SanMar. Internal Drift 0 Copy CSV Within Caspio: CATALOG_COLOR ≠ SANMAR_MAINFRAME_COLOR on the same row. Pre-existing data inconsistency. Caspio Orphans 0 Copy CSV Color exists in Caspio but SanMar's API didn't return it for this style. Likely discontinued by SanMar. SanMar Only 0 Copy CSV SanMar lists these mainframe colors but Caspio has no row. New colors not yet imported. In Sync 0 Caspio matches SanMar. No action needed.
